title: fix(searchbox): SearchBox should not change the state if SearchOnEnterKeyPress
body:
This patch revisits the previous solution to prevent impact on the URL Sync mechanism. It uses the `change` event again and impacts only the behaviour of the SearchBox.

The solution also contains a refactoring that introduces a default value for the queryHook which reduces the control flow complexity.

Staging: http://opposite-girls.surge.sh/

Elements that you can check in the staging website:

* see that the use of the second search box does not trigger an update of the URL
* changing the filters creates new history steps, and you can go back and forth using the browser buttons

fix #2105 #2117
